title: Lanthanide Supermolecular Transformers Induced by K+ and CO2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Ce2L'3]Cl2 (elem. anal. C60H60Ce2Cl2N12O18 after loss of noncoordinated solvent)

synthesis.procedure: A methanol solution (2 mL) containing 0.1 mmol CeCl3·7H2O (37.3 mg) was added in batches to a stirred DMF solution (5 mL) of 0.1 mmol H2L' (41.4 mg). The mixture was stirred in air for 4 h at room temperature, forming a black solution, which was filtered and exposed to air. Black block single crystals of Ce2L'3 suitable for X-ray crystallography were obtained upon slow evaporation over 1 month.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring in air followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and exposed to air; black block crystals by slow evaporation over 1 month

source_locations.location: Results: K+-induced self-assembly; Experimental Methods, Synthesis of Complex 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [K2La2L3(H2O)2]Br2 (elem. anal. C66H76Br2K2La2N12O20 after loss of noncoordinated solvent)

synthesis.procedure: A solution of 0.1 mmol rare-earth halide salt in 2 mL methanol was added to a light-yellow solution of H2L (44.2 mg, 0.1 mmol) with KOH (5.6 mg, 0.2 mmol) in 8 mL methanol plus 0.5 mL DMF. Tetranuclear dimetallic triple-stranded helicate 4a formed by evaporation in air at room temperature over 4 weeks. KOH serves as both base and K+ template. The same 4a assembly also crystallized upon addition of KI to hexanuclear circular helicate 1.

reagents.name: lanthanum halide (product isolated as bromide salt)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly and evaporation in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation in air at room temperature over 4 weeks

properties.summary: UV–vis titration of related [L3La2] in acetonitrile showed a slight decrease at 301 nm and a gradual increase at 390 nm upon addition of 0–4.0 equiv K+, indicating selective K+ binding; other alkali and alkaline-earth cations produced no spectral changes.

measurements.value: decrease at 301 nm; increase at 390 nm

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear quadruple-stranded helicate with encapsulated carbonate

synthesis.procedure: 0.2 mmol LiOH·H2O or 0.2 mmol NaOH and 0.1 mmol H2L (44.2 mg) were added to 8 mL methanol and 0.5 mL DMF and stirred for 10 min. A solution of 0.1 mmol LnCl3·6H2O in 2 mL methanol was added, the mixture was rapidly stirred for 10 min, filtered, and exposed to air. Rhombohedral crystals of [La4L4(CO3)]Cl2 (5a) formed by slow evaporation over several weeks at room temperature in air; atmospheric CO2 is captured and fixed as carbonate.

reagents.name: lithium hydroxide monohydrate or sodium hydroxide
